Title: Azure Site Recovery available in Australia Geo

Body.Content:
Azure Site Recovery is now available in the Australia Geo with the same service-level agreement coverage available in other regions worldwide. This allows customers to create vaults in the Australia datacenters. Azure Site Recovery can help you protect important applications by coordinating the replication and recovery of private clouds across sites, whether you’re protecting dozens or hundreds of virtual machines. You can protect your applications to your own second site or to a hosting service provider's site. You can even use Azure as your disaster recovery site and avoid the expense and complexity of building and managing your own secondary location.

For more information about regional availability for services, visit our Azure Regions page.
